in_sanskrit.name: Chote
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, Small
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chote एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Chote is derived from the Hindi language and translates to 'little' or 'small'. This name is often used for young children or babies, signifying their small size and innocence. In Hindu mythology, the god Ganesha is referred to as Chote Ganesha, meaning 'Little Ganesha'.
